title: Portable smartphone-integrated ratiometric fluorescence probe for visual detection of mercury ions in environmental water with greenness evaluation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,38612-38623
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06396E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Kawan F. Kayani
This study developed a ratiometric fluorescence probe based on red and green carbon dots for the selective detection of Hg2+ and evaluated its environmental sustainability using AGREE, BAGI, and RAPI metrics.
